3. For any linear map, injectivity is equivalent to having a trivial kernel: if Φ(x)=0 then x=0.
4. Let x ∈ ℋ_bulk such that Φ(x)=0. Then ⟨Φ(x),Φ(x)⟩ = ⟨0,0⟩ = 0.

6. By the positive-definiteness of the inner product, ⟨x,x⟩ = 0 implies x = 0.
7. Hence, the kernel of Φ is trivial, so Φ is injective. [T18]
